description: This file defines the VacancyService class within the OrangeHRM Recruitment plugin, which provides methods to access vacancy-related data via a VacancyDao data access object.

classes.name: VacancyService
classes.description: A service class that manages vacancy data, providing access to a VacancyDao instance, and encapsulates business logic related to vacancies.

methods.name: getVacancyDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of VacancyDao, creating one if it doesn't already exist.
